history.overview: The Catacombs were once Dragorn burial tunnels, later seized and corrupted by Muramite invaders.

timeline.name: Dragorn Burial Era
timeline.description: The tunnels were carved as sacred burial chambers for Dragorn ancestors.

timeline.name: Muramite Seizure
timeline.description: Muramite forces invaded Dranik and seized the catacombs for experimentation.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord energy permeated the tunnels, animating the dead and warping the stone.

timeline.name: Resistance Infiltration
timeline.description: Dragorn resistance agents attempted infiltration to sabotage Muramite operations.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The catacombs remain a dangerous labyrinth of undead, Muramites, and Discord anomalies.
